artworks.title: Pool with Deer (La Mare aux cerfs)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, foliage, and a body of water. The perspective is low, offering a detailed view of the natural surroundings. The trees are depicted with fine lines, creating a dense canopy. The vegetation near the viewer includes grasses and leafy plants. Two deer are standing in the water, with their reflections visible. In the background, more trees are visible. The artwork uses a monochrome color palette of grey and black, giving it a classic and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sunrise (Le Lever du soleil)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated view, revealing a pastoral scene. The horizon is placed in the upper third of the composition, meeting rolling hills that fade into the distance. Above the horizon, the sun is partially obscured by fine lines, suggesting rays of light. The technique uses cross-hatching brushstrokes for depth and texture. Closest to us, sparse vegetation and a figure with animals, likely sheep, are visible. In the distance, a line of trees stretches across the scene, aligned with the land's slope. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of gray, enhancing the etched aesthetic of the artwork.

artworks.title: Passe ton chemin, cochon
artworks.description: The image shows a soldier holding a rifle, wearing a fur hat and military uniform. Debris and a fallen figure are on the ground nearby. In the background are indistinct shadows of soldiers, and a cannonball is depicted mid-air.

artworks.title: Dieu ai-je aimé cet être la
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing next to a stone wall. One is a soldier with a blue military hat, coat, white belt, trousers, and black boots, leaning against the wall. The other is a young boy in a brown jacket, green trousers, and a blue cap, standing with hands behind his back. Three stone busts are on the wall. In the background, there is a large building with a French flag flying on top under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Dupin ainé
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person depicted in a monochrome drawing style. The individual is in a side profile position, looking to the viewer's left. This person has strong facial features, including a prominent forehead, nose, and lips. They are wearing round spectacles. Their hair appears short and closely cropped. They are dressed in a formal coat with a high collar and a cravat. The background is softly shaded. Below the portrait, there is an illustration that includes a crest or emblem featuring a central motif of a money pouch, with scrolls, a compass, and a sailing ship. Text accompanies this lower drawing. The image appears to be a caricature or a satirical depiction.

artworks.title: Soult (Maréchal)
artworks.description: The image is a caricature of a man wearing a military uniform. His exaggerated facial features include an elongated face, pronounced cheekbones, and large ears. He is depicted facing slightly right with his head tilted downward. The man has dark, wavy hair and is wearing a uniform with shoulder epaulettes and a sash. Below the caricature is an emblem with a blue shield, a sword, two banners, and text. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Comte d'Argout
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a man in profile facing left from the shoulders up. The man has a large nose, prominent chin, small circular glasses on his nose, slicked back short hair, and distinct sideburns. He is wearing a high-collared shirt and a coat. Below the portrait is a drawing of a medal or emblem with a ribbon and the word "D'ARG....". The background is plain.

artworks.title: J. Claude Fulchiron
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a side profile, with his arms crossed over his chest. He has exaggerated facial features, including a large nose and pronounced chin. The man has short hair combed back, wearing a long, dark coat with a wide collar, trousers, and formal shoes. The illustration is in grayscale with detailed shading for depth. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, focusing on the man.

artworks.title: Harlé père
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man in profile, facing right. He is holding up a large piece of fabric in front of him, inspecting it. The man has distinct facial features, wears glasses, his hair is styled in a receding manner, and he is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and dark shoes. The background is plain, emphasizing the man as the focal point. There is text at the top and bottom, with the name "Mᵐᵉ ARLÉPAIRE" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Comte Horace Sébastiani
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright with his legs slightly apart. His head is turned slightly to the right, revealing a nose and a full mustache. He has slicked-back short hair and is wearing a dark coat with a high collar over a white shirt. The coat has long tails and he is holding a large top hat against his chest. Under his arm, there is a bag or bundle tied with string. The background is blank, with a drawn line indicating a ground surface.

artworks.title: Charles Guillaume Étienne
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a three-quarter view, with exaggerated facial features and formal attire. His hair is styled in waves, and he is holding a pair of spectacles. The background is plain. Age spots are visible on the image.

artworks.title: Antoine Odier
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man in profile with distinct facial features, a slightly large nose, a receding hairline, and wearing spectacles. He is dressed in a dark suit with a frock coat, waistcoat, trousers, and a white shirt. He is holding rolled-up documents labeled "Amor" and "Liberté" in his left arm and a top hat in his right hand. The background is plain, emphasizing the man. The drawing has a caricature style.

artworks.title: Docteur Prunelle
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a suit with his hands behind his back. He has medium-length hair, a frown, and a bow tie.

artworks.title: Félix Barthe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in full-body profile. He has a strong jawline, combed back hair, and wears a suit with a high-collared shirt and a cravat. His left arm is bent, holding a rolled-up document, while his right hand holds a top hat at his side. He stands on a shaded floor, with a plain light-colored background.

artworks.title: Baillot
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a man standing with his hands in his pockets. He is positioned slightly leaning to one side with his lower body facing forward and his head turned to the right. The man has jowly cheeks, a prominent chin, and short, combed-back hair. He is wearing a dark suit with a waistcoat underneath and a cravat tied at the neck. His trousers are somewhat baggy and he is wearing dark shoes. The background is plain. No jewelry or objects are visible in his hands.

artworks.title: Comte de Kératry
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bent-forward stance with distinctive facial features, short dark hair, glasses, and a long overcoat. He is wearing light-colored striped trousers and dark shoes with bows. In his right hand, he holds a top hat, and his left hand touches his chest. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Amiral de Rigny
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile wearing formal attire. He has short, wavy, graying hair, a prominent nose, and a slightly furrowed brow. The man's posture suggests his hands are in his pockets. There are no visible objects or jewelry on him. The background is light-toned, with a shaded floor. The artwork is signed by "h. Daumier" and titled "M'DE RIGN."

artworks.title: Le passé - Le présent - l'Avenir
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature focusing on the upper body of a person. The individual is positioned facing forward with exaggerated head and facial features. The facial expression is stern, with squinted eyes, thick eyebrows, a bulbous nose, and a pronounced frown. The person is wearing a dark jacket with a white collared shirt and a cravat. The background is plain, and there are French words at the bottom of the image: "le passé," "le présent," and "l'avenir," which translate to "the past," "the present," and "the future."

artworks.title: Gros Cupide, va!
artworks.description: The image shows a standing man with a slouch, slightly leaning to his right. He has exaggerated facial features like a prominent nose and large sideburns, closed eyes, and a content expression. He wears a military-style hat with dark hair peeking out, a dark coat with decorations and epaulets, holding his belly with one hand. A sword hangs from his belt. He wears light trousers and dark shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Voyage a travers les populations empressées
artworks.description: This is an image of a rider on a horse in a barren landscape. The scene features a rider wearing a large hat and coat, facing away, mounted on a horse. The background is sparse, with birds flying in the sky. In the foreground, there are figures on the ground. The terrain looks rugged and inhospitable, creating an atmosphere of hardship. The style of the drawing is caricature-like, with exaggerated features and a dramatic mood.

artworks.title: Repos de la France
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on an ornate chair with animal head carvings on the armrests. His legs are spread out and rest on cannon barrels. He wears light-colored trousers and a dark jacket, with a white top hat partly covering his face. Beside him stands a woman covered in a shawl, facing towards him. The plain background highlights the figures and the chair.

artworks.title: Baissez le rideau, la farce est jouée (Lower the Curtain, the Farce is Over)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theater scene with a large clownish figure and an audience. The drawing shows a theatrical performance with a character resembling a clown on the right, and an audience on the left. The audience is depicted in rows, with a seated figure above operating the curtain. The scene conveys a sense of theatricality and humor, capturing the atmosphere of a performance.

artworks.title: La tête branlante
artworks.description: The image shows a crowd of people around a person sitting on a platform carried by others. The seated individual wears a large pointed hat and a cape. The crowd consists mostly of men wearing different types of hats. The background is filled with more people, creating a sense of depth and a large audience.

artworks.title: Les honneurs du Panthéon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a procession. The scene features exaggerated, caricature-like figures hanging from ropes within a classical architectural setting. Each figure appears to represent individuals of different professions, potentially political or social figures, as suggested by the labeled elements they carry, like papers and bags filled with money. The composition is symmetrical, with figures on either side of a central anchor motif in the background. The setting includes an inscription in French above: "Aux Grands Hommes La Patrie Reconnaissante," which translates to "To the Great Men, the Grateful Homeland."
